Chose: The Go indexer fills in where a declaration ends

where indexers/go/main.go file page

quote func declEnds(path string) map[int32]int32 {

Because (Claude, measured): scip-go v0.1.23 records where a definition's name is, not where the declaration ends, so every function came out one line long, and a quote in its body was never found. Go's own parser knows where each declaration ends, from the standard library, with no new dependency. The guide makes it part of the contract that a range is the whole declaration.
